area_of_interest.description: Approximate Texas Renaissance Festival campground and festival envelope; not a property or campsite boundary.

sources.title: Fields of New Market 2026 Season Pass Plotting Map v3.2
sources.use: Broad restricted, parking, camping, Family Camping, and Revel Camping context for season-pass land planning.
sources.limitations: Not a scale drawing, individual campsite boundary, approval record, or survey.

sources.title: Fields of New Market Campground Map
sources.use: Road names, camping areas, gates, services, landmarks, emergency exits, and orientation.
sources.limitations: Copyrighted schematic; not georeferenced and not survey-grade. The repository viewer references the official hosted copy rather than claiming ownership.

sources.title: Texas NAIP 2022 Natural Color / Color Infrared 60 cm
sources.authority: Texas Geographic Information Office / USDA NAIP
sources.use: Trees, clearings, roads, surface drainage traces, and ground context.

sources.title: USGS Topographic Map
sources.use: Topography, hydrography, roads, contours where available, and regional context.
sources.limitations: Planning-scale map; verify elevations with field measurements when exact grade matters.

sources.title: USGS Imagery with Topographic Labels
sources.use: Aerial context combined with roads, names, and hydrographic labels.

sources.title: USGS Shaded Relief
sources.use: Reconnaissance of slopes, swales, and drainage direction.
sources.limitations: Not a replacement for a site survey or detailed digital elevation model analysis.

sources.title: Grimes CAD Web Service - Parcels
sources.limitations: Appraisal mapping is not a boundary survey. Owner names are intentionally excluded from downloaded project data.

sources.title: Grimes CAD Web Service - Streets
sources.limitations: Does not necessarily include every internal campground road.

sources.title: Grimes CAD Web Service - County Boundary
sources.limitations: Not relevant to exact campsite placement.

sources.title: National Flood Hazard Layer - Flood Hazard Zones
sources.use: Screening for mapped flood hazards and flood-zone context.
sources.limitations: Absence of a mapped zone does not mean a campsite cannot pond or flood during heavy rain.

sources.title: National Wetlands Inventory
sources.use: Screening for mapped wetlands and hydric landscape features.
sources.limitations: Map inventory is not a jurisdictional wetland determination.

sources.title: Soil Survey Geographic Database / Web Soil Survey
sources.type: official soils database and AOI map/report tool
sources.use: Soil drainage, ponding, flooding frequency, hydric rating, and engineering/recreation limitations.
sources.limitations: Requires an exact AOI and correct interpretation of soil-map scale and map-unit composition.
